System → General — theme section with preset swatches, live preview (theme-customizer.js), saved with General form.
themes.css + html classes/data attributes in public layout; theme.js respects admin default mode and toggle setting.
Login/2FA inherit PublicTheme presets, fonts, radius, accent, and default color mode via themes.css + auth.css.
pub_theme_blog_width in General settings (inherit / narrow / normal / wide) for /blog listing.
